mapper.select:
select ar.id, ar.content, ar.img, ar.like_count, ar.comment_count as commentCount, ar.create_time, CASE WHEN (SELECT count(1) FROM user_to_like ut WHERE ut.del_flag = 0 AND ut.praise_type = 'ARTICLE' AND ut.target_id = ar.id AND ut.user_id = #{ownerId}) = 0 then false else true end as isLike, CASE WHEN ar.user_id = #{ownerId} then true ELSE FALSE END AS isDelete, ar.open, ar.city, ar.type FROM article ar
ar.del_flag = 0 and ar.user_id = #{userId}
and ar.open = 1
ORDER BY ar.create_time desc, ar.id DESC

select ar.id, ar.content, tu.id as userId, tu.avatar as headPortrait, tu.sex as gender, tu.nick_name as nickName, tu.job_mes, tu.birth_date, ar.img, ar.like_count, ar.comment_count as commentCount, ar.create_time, CASE WHEN (SELECT count(1) FROM user_to_like ut WHERE ut.del_flag = 0 AND ut.praise_type = 'ARTICLE' AND ut.target_id = ar.id AND ut.user_id = #{ownerId}) = 0 then false else true end as isLike, CASE WHEN ar.user_id = #{ownerId} then true ELSE FALSE END AS isDelete, ar.open, ar.city, ar.type FROM article ar left join t_user tu on ar.user_id=tu.id
ar.del_flag = 0 and tu.del_flag=0 and tu.status='ENABLE' and ar.open = 1 and (ar.recommend='1' or ar.user_id = #{ownerId})
and ar.city=#{city}
and (select count(1) from article_to_subject ats where del_flag = 0 and ats.article_id=ar.id and ats.subject_id=#{subjectId})>0
and ar.id=#{articleId}
and (tu.sex = #{sex} or ar.id = #{articleId} or ar.sort=99)
ORDER BY (IFNULL(ar.like_count, 0) + IFNULL(ar.comment_count, 0)) desc,ar.create_time DESC, ar.id DESC
ORDER BY ar.create_time DESC, ar.id DESC
ORDER BY ar.sort DESC, ar.create_time DESC, ar.id DESC

SELECT ac.id, ac.user_id, fu.avatar as headPortrait, fu.sex as gender, fu.nick_name as nickName, concat( fu.residential_city, '·', fu.job_mes ) as information, ac.content, ac.like_count, CASE
WHEN (SELECT count(1) FROM user_to_like ut WHERE ut.del_flag = 0 AND ut.praise_type = 'COMMENT' AND ut.target_id = ac.id AND ut.user_id = #{userId}) = 0 then false else true end as isLike, ac.create_time, CASE
WHEN ac.user_id = #{userId} then true else false end as deleteBtn, ac.anonymous, ac.comment_id, acc.content as replyContent, tuu.nick_name as replyNickName, acc.user_id as replyUserId FROM article_comment ac LEFT JOIN t_user fu ON ac.user_id = fu.id left join article_comment acc on ac.comment_id = acc.id left join t_user tuu on acc.user_id = tuu.id WHERE ac.del_flag = 0 and fu.del_flag = 0 and fu.status = 'ENABLE' and ac.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY ac.create_time DESC, ac.id DESC
SELECT asu.id, asu.title, asu.img, asu.description_info, asu.visit_count, asu.discuss_count FROM article_subject asu WHERE asu.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY asu.sort ASC, asu.id DESC
